FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 20 Cont.
Aug. 23 2nd retreat began - 14 Hol. Masses daily. Boys did well A. Ahearn, G. Gorman, E. Bly & Fr. O Brien served at 6 o cl, J. McCarthy, E. Holden, W. Hayes & Fr. Th. Fagan at 6.30 -- etc.
Aug. 31 Charles O Hare alone came to serve the 10 o cl High Mass Served with the Student Elsner
Sept. 1st Labor Day (excitement) A Beautiful day & fine Crowd.
Sept. 3rd Altar boys outing to Ft. Hamilton. Had pleasant day but some were wayward.
Page 21
From Brooklyn Bridge to Dykeman was hot riding - crowded subway.
This same Evening returning we saw nice part of Merchants parade - new ornamental lights being first used. Gety Sq. Crowded.
Same To-day Rev. P. Bruno left for Mt. Cello for a visit of some weeks Rev. P. Superior accompanying him thither.
Sept 4 Students returned with three new ones - 12 altogether. To-day Corner-Stone ordered from Ireland.
Sept. 10 The Choir-boys are off to Prospect Park for day outing.
Sept. 11 Mayor Ganor of N. Y. City died suddenly on board for Europe - Was brought back and burried from St. John's Episcopal "Cathedral", Though deceased had once been a member of the Christian Brothers.
Sept. 28th Fr. Solanus starts Today for Seattle where his parents are to celebrate golden jubilee of their wedding, October 6th, 1863.
